rationale: New per-marker system-LQI opt-out, own physical sibling-LQI inheritance for entity markers and canonical multi-channel topology representation are user-facing capabilities beyond v1.80.1. Existing battery inheritance is reused and tested, not advertised as a newly implemented feature. Physical-radio room deduplication and resize endpoint alignment accompany this coherent diagnostic contract.

summary.ru: Локальное скрытие сигнала и собственная Zigbee-диагностика для отдельных каналов без повторных связей и лишнего веса в среднем комнаты.
summary.en: Per-marker signal hiding and own-device Zigbee diagnostics for individual channels, without duplicate routes or room-average weighting.
